title: Shortest Safe Route
description: Use the collected route fragments to find the minimum number of safe corridor steps from Delta Hall to the locked lab.
prompt: Graph edges: A-B 2, A-C 5, B-D 2, C-D 1, D-E 3. What is the shortest distance from A to E?
publicHints: The answer is a single integer.
Player A and Player B each see different graph fragments in the room.
